build_custom_augmentation: build a list of image augmentation transforms from a detectron2 config for training or inference
build_custom_transform_gen: build image transform pipeline using the backward-compatible alias for build_custom_augmentation
create_efficientdet_resize_crop: create an EfficientDet-style resize crop augmentation with configurable size and scale range
create_resize_shortest_edge: create a resize augmentation that scales images to a specified shortest edge length
create_random_flip_augmentation: create a random horizontal or vertical flip augmentation appended to training pipelines
